about: Passages anchored in the text of Atkore's live FY2025 10-K on 2026-09-13, one sentence per section. The fixture beside this file was rebuilt from the same filing and its spacing differs slightly, so these anchors are what a passage kept against the live filing looks like when the text has since shifted. Only the anchors are recorded here; which strategy should find each one is stated in the tests.
